 Order

This petition has been filed by the petitioner under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. for quashment of the complaint which is pending before JMFC Gwalior in RCT Case No.1111/2013 for the offence under Section 58 and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006.
2. At the out set, counsel for the petitioner submits that this petition has rendered infructuous.
3. In view of the aforesaid, nothing survives in this petition to address upon and the same is hereby dismissed having been rendered infructuous.
